sentences.text:
Petitioner is aggrieved by an order passed by the authority under the Food Safety and Standards Act,
2006.
Admittedly, this order under challenge is subject to appeal contemplated under Section 70 of the Act.
Since such remedy has not been availed, we decline to interfere in the writ petition.
The writ petition is, accordingly, dismissed.
